lastSavedTimestamp.description:
Timestamp of the last saved version.  Subsequent updates to an instance will retain a `versionEdits` entry
to get back to the state of the instance at this time.  If this is null, there has been no explicit save
and no history will be retained until `updateAndSave` has been called.

savedVersion.description:
Maintains the saved version number.  If the latest version isn't saved, this will be `-1`.  As versions
are saved they are assigned saved versions numbers starting at 1.  There will be no gaps between saved
version numbers for saved versions.

versionEdits.description:
Every update to types that mix this type in will retain `versionEdit` entries to enable going back to any
previously saved version.

Completely and automatically managed by the system.

title:
Allows saving specific versions.  Every update to types that mix this type in will retain a `versionEdit` to
go back to the last saved version.  Also, `versionEdit` entries will be retained to back to any previously
saved version.

This type is intended to be used for user-interactive types that benefit from an explicit "save" model.  It is
not suitable to be used with types that are largely populated via dataload.

When mixing in this type, along with Configurable and/or AclEnabled, Configurable should be mixed in first,
followed by AclEnabled then this (as appropriate).
name: Versionable
